methods.name: Emulator file loading
requires: A legally obtained or self-built ROM/image
methods.description: Load the target-specific ROM or homebrew image as a file in an emulator.

methods.name: ROM cartridge
requires: A compatible cartridge board or flash cartridge
methods.description: The console reads the program through its cartridge interface. A ROM file alone cannot be inserted into a console.

methods.name: Flash cartridge with SD storage
requires: A supported SD card and filesystem
methods.description: The SD card is read by a flash cartridge that plugs into the console. This is not standalone SD boot.

methods.name: Homebrew loader
requires: A console model with a compatible homebrew-loading method
methods.description: A supported console software/firmware path loads the homebrew image. Availability depends on exact model and firmware.

methods.name: Linux boot media
requires: Hardware with a supported Linux boot chain
A compatible kernel and device tree
A prepared SD, USB or internal-storage image
methods.description: Boot a real Linux kernel only on hardware with the required boot firmware, memory-management hardware, RAM and drivers.
